# PromptReel Lab

> Free, photo-first AI ad prompts for ecommerce brands, with before/after renders. Prompts are written for ChatGPT image generation so the real product stays accurate. The full vault (300+ prompts across 8 niches, 40 before/after pairs) is a paid membership on Whop.
